question.en: How long has Mr. Page been teaching?
question.zh: 佩奇先生教了多少年书？

sentences.en: How long has Mr. Page been teaching?
sentences.zh: 佩奇先生教了多少年书？

sentences.en: I have just received a letter from my old school, informing me that my former headmaster,
sentences.zh: 我刚收到母校的一封信，通知我说我的前校长

chunks.x: informing me that my former headmaster

sentences.en: Mr. Stuart Page, will be retiring next week.
sentences.zh: 斯图尔特·佩奇先生将于下星期退休。

sentences.en: Pupils of the school old and new, will be sending him a present to mark the occasion.
sentences.zh: 学校的新老学生将送他一件礼物以纪念这个日子。

sentences.en: All those who have contributed towards the gift will sign their names in a large album which will be sent to the headmaster's home.
sentences.zh: 所有为礼物出过钱的人都将在一本大相册上签名，相册将送到校长家里。

chunks.x: in a large album which will be sent to the headmaster 's home

sentences.en: We shall all remember Mr. Page for his patience and understanding and for the kindly encouragement he gave us when we went so unwillingly to school.
sentences.zh: 我们都会记住佩奇先生的耐心和理解，以及我们极不情愿上学时他给予我们的亲切鼓励。

chunks.x: for his patience and understanding and

sentences.en: A great many former pupils will be attending a farewell dinner in his honour next Thursday.
sentences.zh: 许多老同学将参加下星期四为他举行的告别宴会。

sentences.en: It is a curious coincidence that the day before his retirement, Mr. Page will have been teaching for a total of forty years.
sentences.zh: 一个奇妙的巧合是，到他退休的前一天，佩奇先生将已教满四十年书。

chunks.x: for a total of forty years

sentences.en: After he has retired he will devote himself to gardening.
sentences.zh: 退休后他将致力于园艺。

sentences.en: For him, this will be an entirely new hobby.
sentences.zh: 对他来说，这将是一个全新的爱好。

sentences.en: But this does not matter, for, as he has often remarked, one is never too old to learn.
sentences.zh: 但这没有关系，因为正如他常说的，人要活到老学到老。
